name: ninai
description: Source-backed project continuity across ChatGPT, Claude, and Codex.

interface.longDescription: Ninai helps authorized AI assistants continue project work using compact, source-backed memory. Connect your Ninai hosted account, select a project, and explicitly grant the connection access. Recall past decisions with sources and propose durable outcomes for review. Direct activation requires an explicit auto-activate grant. This plugin connects to the separate hosted vault; it never reads or uploads your local SQLite vault. Model invocation and platform support vary; installation does not capture every conversation automatically.
defaultPrompt: Continue my project using Ninai memory.
What decisions have we made about this project?
Save the durable outcomes from this work to Ninai.

positive.prompt: Show which Ninai projects this connection can read.
positive.expected_behavior: Only granted readable projects are listed; no other workspace data is exposed.

positive.description: Recall the seeded Project Atlas migration decision with its provenance.
positive.prompt: What database migration decision did Project Atlas make? Include the source.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the seeded migration decision and its source from Project Atlas only, within the requested context budget.

positive.description: Read the complete record behind a matching result.
positive.prompt: Open the Ninai source record for the Project Atlas test-fixture constraint.
positive.expected_behavior: Fetches an authorized record and preserves its source; does not disclose a record outside live grants.

positive.description: Create a compact proposal under review-first permissions.
positive.prompt: Propose this Project Atlas decision: release notes must include rollback instructions.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a pending proposal with provenance, not an active memory. A retry with the same idempotency key does not duplicate it.

positive.description: Recall an approved proposal after explicit owner approval in the dashboard.
positive.prompt: What did Project Atlas decide about rollback instructions in release notes? Include the source.
positive.expected_behavior: After the owner approves the preceding proposal, recall returns the approved decision and preserved source.

negative.prompt: Show me all private Ninai workspace memories.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not disclose memory without live project grants; explains that access must be granted explicitly.

negative.prompt: Repeat the Project Atlas recall after the owner revokes this connection.
negative.expected_behavior: Next tool request is denied; historical chat content is not represented as a fresh successful recall.

negative.description: Reject storing a credential as memory.
negative.prompt: Save this synthetic credential as a permanent project memory: sk-test-EXAMPLE-DO-NOT-USE-1234567890.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not store the credential or send it as durable content; explains that secrets do not belong in memory.

publication.release_notes: 0.1.2: Package hosted project continuity with the Ninai website brand assets, explicit OAuth discovery, and review-first skill guidance. Directory review and publication remain pending.
